label: Marshmallow's Mama
text: You found Marshmallow's Mama! Come here, little kitten. I've saved you a cuddle!
direction: A loving middle-aged mother with a warm female voice and a soft British accent. Smile warmly; gentle relief and affection. Natural medium pitch, clear and reassuring.

label: Marshmallow's Papa
text: I'm Marshmallow's Papa! Well done, brave kitten. That was a purr-fect rescue!
direction: A middle-aged father with a rounded male voice, a gentle American accent and a lower comfortable pitch. Proud, affectionate, slightly playful; a soft chuckle in the tone, not a separate laugh.

label: Marshmallow's Granny
text: Oh, my darling! You found Marshmallow's Granny. I've got a cuddle for you!
direction: An elderly grandmother with a gentle female voice and a soft British accent. Cozy, patient and lightly textured, with loving warmth. Natural age, not a frail or exaggerated cartoon voice.

label: Marshmallow's Big Sister — Cocoa
text: Ta-da! I'm Cocoa, Marshmallow's big sister! You found me! Let's play!
direction: A youthful older sister with a bright female voice and a light British accent. Friendly, mischievous and lively, with a smile. Naturally youthful without squeaking, shouting or baby talk.

label: Marshmallow's Baby Brother — Snowflake
text: Peekaboo! It's me, Snowflake! Marshmallow's baby brother! Mew mew!
direction: Preserve the original baby recording exactly; do not regenerate.

label: Marshmallow's Grandpa
text: I'm Marshmallow's Grandpa! Well done, little explorer. You made my whiskers smile!
direction: An elderly grandfather with a warm male voice, a soft British accent and a deep comfortable pitch. Slightly gravelly but clear, calm and fond, with a gentle smile. Never stern or booming.

label: Phoebe's Mama
text: You found Phoebe's Mama! Oh, clever kitten. Come and get your snuggle!
direction: A loving middle-aged mother with a mellow female voice and a subtle Canadian English accent. Tender and relieved, slightly lower natural pitch, unhurried and comforting.

label: Phoebe's Papa
text: I'm Phoebe's Papa! Well done, little sunshine! Cuddle time!
direction: A middle-aged father with an easygoing male voice and a gentle Australian accent. Warm, sunny and proud; natural middle pitch, friendly energy, never loud.

label: Phoebe's Granny
text: Oh, my whiskers! You found Phoebe's Granny. I knitted you a great big hug!
direction: An elderly grandmother with a soft female voice and a gentle American accent. Warm, slightly husky, quietly amused and affectionate; slower natural phrasing, not an exaggerated old-person imitation.

label: Phoebe's Big Brother — Tiger
text: I'm Tiger, Phoebe's big brother! That was roar-some! Let's explore!
direction: A youthful older brother with a friendly male voice and a light Australian accent. Playful, energetic and protective, bright natural pitch; no roaring sound effects and no shouting.

label: Phoebe's Baby Sister — Patches
text: Hee hee! I'm Patches, Phoebe's baby sister! Wanna play?
direction: Preserve the original baby recording exactly; do not regenerate.
originalDirection: female, child, high pitch, british accent

label: Phoebe's Grandpa
text: You found Phoebe's Grandpa! Hello, little adventurer. I've got a story just for you!
direction: An elderly grandfather with a mellow male voice and a gentle American accent. Softly textured, relaxed, affectionate storyteller, medium-low natural pitch with a tiny amused smile.
